ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MIRROR_IMAGE_POWER.des: One stack per mirror (base cap 9). Exhausted cards - and an Exhaust copy of the first card you play each turn - are stored into free mirrors. At the start of your turn, each loaded mirror plays its stored card; non-Exhaust Attacks and Skills return once and gain Exhaust. Each instance of unblocked damage you take kills one mirror (empty ones first). Stored cards are shown in this icon's hover tips.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MEMORY_POWER.title: Memory
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MEMORY_POWER.descripti: Whenever one of your [gold]mirror images[/gold] dies, draw 2 cards and gain 1 [img]res://illusionist/art/illusionist_energy_icon_text.webp[/img].
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_KALEIDOSCOPE_POWER.des: Every 5 cards you play, create a mirror image and deal 6 damage to all enemies.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_DAZZLE_POWER.title: Dazzle
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_DAZZLE_POWER.descripti: At the start of each turn, gain {TotalBlock} [gold]Block[/gold].
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_CASCADE_POWER.title: Cascade
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_CASCADE_POWER.descript: At the start of each turn, [gold]Copy[/gold] {Amount}.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_REKINDLE_POWER.title: Rekindle
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_REKINDLE_POWER.descrip: At the start of your next turn, [gold]Copy[/gold] {Amount} mirror images, then this expires.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_TRANSMUTE_POWER.title: Transmute
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_TRANSMUTE_POWER.descri: At the end of your turn, each transmuted card [gold]transforms[/gold] into the card it was before its latest [gold]transform[/gold].
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_FLUXWEAVE_POWER.title: Fluxweave
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_FLUXWEAVE_POWER.descri: For every 2 cards you transform, draw 1 card.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_IMPROVISE_POWER.title: Improvise
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_IMPROVISE_POWER.descri: Each turn, the first {Amount} cards you transmute are each played at a random enemy.
Counts the cards you have transformed this turn.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MOMENTUM_POWER.title: Momentum
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MOMENTUM_POWER.descrip: Counts toward drawing a card and gaining energy every 10 transforms. Counter shown on power icon.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_REFRACTION_POWER.title: Refraction
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_REFRACTION_POWER.descr: Whenever you transform a card, deal {Amount} damage to a random enemy.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_EXTRACT_POWER.title: Extract
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_EXTRACT_POWER.descript: Gain 1 energy at the start of each turn.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_SHIELD_TAX_POWER.title: Shield Tax
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_SHIELD_TAX_POWER.descr: Whenever creatures gain a total of {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold]. Progress toward the next Strength is shown on the power icon.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_FALSE_REFUGE_POWER.des: Whenever an enemy gains [gold]Block[/gold], it loses HP equal to {Amount} times the [gold]Block[/gold] gained.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_IMAGINED_FOE_POWER.des: At the start of your turn, ALL creatures (you, allies, and every enemy) gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_PHASE_SHIFT_POWER.desc: The next time you take unblocked damage, your mirror images do not die.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_EVERLIT_LAMP_POWER.des: The first time each turn an Extinguished Lamp appears in your hand, Transmute it into a Dim Lamp.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_RESONANCE_POWER.title: Resonance
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_RESONANCE_POWER.descri: Each turn, the first {Amount} times you play a card in your hand that shares a name with a card stored in your mirrors, it costs 1 less.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_PHANTASM_STORM_POWER.d: At the start of your turn, destroy a mirror image.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MIRROR_CAP_UP_POWER.de: Your mirror cap is increased by {Amount}.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_STARGAZING_POWER.title: Waiting in the Wings
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_STARGAZING_POWER.descr: At the start of your turn, draw {Amount} card(s), then put {Amount} card(s) on top of your draw pile.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_CUT_IN_POWER.title: Cut In
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_CUT_IN_POWER.descripti: This creature's number of attacks is reduced by {Amount} this turn.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_CURTAIN_BREAK_POWER.de: Whenever you break an enemy's [gold]Block[/gold], draw 2 cards and gain 1 Energy.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MESMERIZING_ARRAY_POWE: The first time each turn you change an enemy's intent, [gold]Copy[/gold] {Amount} and draw {Amount} card(s).
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_MISDIRECTION_POWER.des: Whenever you transform a card this turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_BURN_THE_CITY_POWER.de: At the start of each turn, afflict a card in your hand with Scorching.
ILLUSIONIST_POWER_FANTASY_STORM_POWER.de: The first {Amount} time(s) each turn you Exhaust a card, all mirror images Execute.
